init.title: Repeat the orders of {shade} more?
init.description: {device} sends each order for **{shade}** with {current} repeat(s); {recommended} are advised from what the board measures. With too few repeats, one lost frame is one ignored order, and the shade only answers "sometimes". Submit to set {recommended} repeats on the board.

weak_link.description: The guided measurement of **{shade}** is only {margin} dB above the noise of {device}. More repeats rarely save such a link: move the board or its antenna, or add a repeater, then measure again from the RF diagnostics page of the board.
